Have you seen our Top 25 B2B Saas Founders of 2024 list yet? You nominated dozens of incredible founders, and we picked the top 25 based on their history of innovation, effective leadership, and strategy. 💪

On Tuesday, we shared the first 13 names on the list, and today, we’re sharing the final 12. 

Each and every name on our Top 25 Founderst list belongs to a B2B SaaS founder who’s shaping the future of our shared industry, and making the world a better place at the same time. 💥

Andrew Breen | Founder & CEO | Outshine
David Chevalier | Co-Founder & CEO | Surfe
Alex Circei | Co-Founder and CEO | Waydev
Mark Corbett | Founder | Thrust Carbon
Pranjal Daga | Co-Founder and Co-CEO | Accend (YC S23) 
Sachin Dev Duggal | Chief Wizard | Builder.ai
Garry Drummond, CISSP, CWNA, CWSP | Founder & CEO | LOCH Technologies
Jennifer Dulski | CEO & Founder | Rising Team
Henrik Grim | Co-Founder & CEO | Mimo
Ajay Kamble | Co-Founder & CEO | Revalgo
Amir Kaplan | Co-Founder & CEO | ifeel - Humanising Growth
Jimmy Kim | Founder & CIO | Sendlane

For the full list, take a look here: https://bit.ly/46bgJr0
